title: Supporting Literacy Assessment in West Africa: Using State-of-the-Art Speech Models to Evaluate Oral Reading Fluency

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of automatic speech recognition (ASR) models when transcribing audio from Ghanaian students (who speak with regional accents and often speak English as a second language) against a baseline dataset of American students.
Evaluating the performance of ASR models specifically on datasets of children's speech and comparing the resulting Word Error Rates (WER) to established benchmarks for adult speech transcription.
